SUPERSEDED DIAGNOSIS. This was recorded as 'sandbox limitation, health undetermined' after zizmor got HTTP 401 fetching actions/checkout. That 401 is real but environmental: the sandbox exports a 14-character sentinel GH_TOKEN which makes zizmor switch from offline to online mode, and github.com rejects the sentinel at git-upload-pack. Unauthenticated `git ls-remote` to the same URL succeeds. Re-run with GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN unset, zizmor runs offline and the gate proceeds - and then finds a REAL issue, so the repo's health is fail, not undetermined.
